title: Miss Attitude
tagline: Life is full of things we feel but never say.

scenes.vo: In our office, we had a name for her. "Miss Attitude." She never smiled. Never came for lunch. For one year, we were sure we knew her.
Every day at one o'clock, all of us went down for lunch. Pizza, biryani. We'd ask her once. She'd say, "You guys go."
So we stopped asking. Someone said she thinks she's better than us. We laughed. I laughed too.
Then one day, I went back up for my phone. The floor was empty. Except her.
She was in the pantry corner, eating two dry rotis from a steel tiffin. Phone on her ear. "Haan Papa, I'll send the dialysis money on Friday. Don't worry."
She saw me. Smiled, for the first time. "Please don't tell anyone." That's when I understood. She was never rude. She was just carrying something none of us could see.
Next time someone stays quiet, don't give them a name. Ask once more. Follow Life, Unsaid for more.
